title: FIFAGami - first-ever international meetings
description: Scheduled fixtures between national teams that have never played each other, from FIFAGami.

items.title: Singapore v Paraguay - first ever men's meeting
items.content_text: Singapore and Paraguay have never played a men's international against each other. They are scheduled to meet for the first time on 2026-11-13 (International Friendly).
